slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video, positioned absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover behind all content. autoPlay muted loop playsInline, NO overlay/tint applied, so it must read cleanly under dark-green and dark-grey text in the upper-left quadrant.

Square monogram mark in the navbar lockup beside the SPEAK/UP wordmark (w-8 h-8 md:w-9 md:h-9). Authored as an inline 256x256 viewBox SVG path in Logo.tsx that takes a `color` prop applied as fill; default #2D2D2F. Supply as a single-path/currentColor-style mark so the fill prop keeps tinting it.

Mobile chrome icons from lucide-react: [0] Menu (hamburger trigger), [1] X (close button inside the full-screen overlay). Tinted #2D2D2F via currentColor. Generic UI affordance, not brand art, but swappable with the brand icon set.

Serif display face used ONLY for the H1 ('Crafting the / improbable'), rendered via the .font-recoleta utility / Tailwind `recoleta` family at text-[56px]->lg:text-[128px], leading-[1.05], tracking-tight. Native family '"Recoleta Regular", serif', loaded from db.onlinewebfonts.com stylesheet link in index.html.

Sans UI/body face applied globally to html/body and to nav links, wordmark, buttons, and the paragraph. Native family 'Inter, sans-serif', weights 400/500/600/700, loaded from Google Fonts in index.html.

mechanic: Static fullscreen (100vh, min-h 600px) hero: an autoplay object-cover background video sits untreated behind a top navbar and an upper-left Recoleta H1 + Inter paragraph + pill CTA, with a useState-toggled full-screen white mobile menu overlay and transition-colors green hovers as the only motion.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS (tailwind.config.js extends fontFamily recoleta/inter and colors brand.green/brand.dark; src/index.css has @tailwind directives + body Inter + .font-recoleta); lucide-react for Menu/X icons; fonts loaded via <link> in index.html. Components: Logo.tsx, Hero.tsx, App.tsx.
reskinNotes:
Heavy hardcoding in markup: the green heading (#0E7824) and dark text/buttons (#2D2D2F / #FFFFFF) appear both as Tailwind theme tokens (brand.green, brand.dark) AND as inline arbitrary values (text-[#2D2D2F], bg-[#2D2D2F], hover:bg-black) so a reskin must touch both the config and the JSX. The wordmark is split into two weight spans ('SPEAK' bold + 'UP' black) and all copy (5 nav labels, two CTA labels 'Begin a venture', the two H1 lines, the two paragraph sentences) is literal in the JSX. The logo is an inline single-path SVG with the brand hex passed via a `color` prop (no asset file). Hero text occupies a fixed upper-left zone over an un-overlaid video, so legibility depends on the video keeping that quadrant calm. H1 sizing/spacing (text-[128px], leading-[1.05], tracking-tight) is tuned to Recoleta's metrics; the responsive
line breaks in the headline and paragraph are baked into the markup.
